mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear and pleasant 56 degrees at Verona Community Park. We are currently under a First Quarter moon, though there will be no ISS sightings this evening.

To stay informed, the City of Verona offers several resources including the VHAT cable channel, a monthly digital newsletter, and active social media pages. You can also visit the city website to learn about proper vehicle parking rules, which require cars to be stored in dedicated spaces at least five feet from property lines, or check out the food scrap program to help reduce landfill waste.

We have a busy schedule today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, a free performance at Concerts in the Park, and trivia over at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, tomorrow features live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly look at local reports, on July 15, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Prairie Oaks Drive, resulting in the arrest of a 30-year-old man for felony bail jumping.

Today's featured flavor is the decadent Really Reese's. The store is currently closed, but they will be opening up at 10:00 AM. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor will be the tasty Chocolate Volcano.
